Lead profile: SMB support SaaS (multi-tenant). Primary product = in-app chat + email summarization + ticket routing. Early discovery; goal is self-serve hosted API but want realistic perf/cost numbers before scaling.

User quotes / highlights:
- CTO (M. Alvarez): "Quality matters for customer-facing answers — hallucination tolerance is low."
- PM (L. Chen): "Prefer models our engs know (Llama), but open to Mistral/Qwen if cost/latency wins."

Model questions raised on call:
- Llama 2 / Llama 3 variants: familiarity + good baseline for chat; concerns about token cost at 8k+ context lengths.
- Mistral / Mistral-Instruct: reportedly better quality-per-cost in some public benchmarks; want Redwood-hosted latency samples.
- Qwen family: curious about multi-modal and long-context tradeoffs; cost unknown.
- Quantization options: want to understand 8-bit/4-bit effect on latency vs quality in Hosted API (any Redwood-prescribed profiles?).

Requirements summary:
- Latency target: 150-300ms p50 for single-turn chat (message sizes ~200-600 tokens).
- Throughput: modest (150-300 requests/day initially), bursty during business hours.
- Cost sensitivity: SMB budget-conscious; looking for predictable token pricing and guidance on cost/per-response optimization.
- Security: SOC2 required; SSO (SAML) for admin access; audit logs for API keys; 90-day retention preferred.

Next steps noted by AE:
- Provide short (1-page) model comparison: expected quality, token cost delta, example latency on hosted tier for 200/600 token calls.
- Grant $500 trial credit + instructions to run 3 benchmark calls (Llama-2, Mistral-instruct, Qwen-lite) via Hosted API.
- Schedule SE session to help run the bench and interpret results (aim for 2026-03-18).
